metadata.description: Clipping masks, sibling stencil mechanics, container overflow clipping, and Photoshop blend modes

sibling_clipping_mask.concept: An element marked with 'clip: true;' acts as a stencil mask for the immediately following sibling element.

exporter_mapping.svg: Generates clipPath definition and attaches clip-path="url(#...)" to sibling
exporter_mapping.skia: Executes ctx.save(), clip(), renders sibling, then ctx.restore()
exporter_mapping.psd: Attaches native vector mask (vmsk) to target layer
